data.one_liner: Dart client for Supabase Realtime, listening to PostgreSQL changes via WebSocket
data.what_it_does: It connects to a Supabase Realtime server over WebSocket and streams database change events. It supports both protocol versions 1.0.0 and 2.0.0 and handles reconnection logic.
use_when: You need real-time updates from a Supabase PostgreSQL database
You want a lightweight client without extra dependencies
You prefer a pure Dart implementation over JavaScript
avoid_when: You already use supabase_flutter which bundles realtime
You need advanced authentication or storage features beyond realtime
strengths: Handles reconnection and null cell values gracefully
weaknesses: No UI helpers, only data layer
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, call RealtimeClient.connect(url, token) and subscribe to channels

alternatives.name: supabase_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a higher-level client with auth, storage, and realtime bundled together
